facts.fact: The Ministry of Transport and Communications issued Botswana's National Broadband Strategy (final, June 2018), stating that the Government has developed it with targets of 2 Mbps for 50% of citizens by end 2014 and 20 Mbps for 90% of the population by 2018, with the Information Age Council to guide implementation and monitor progress; the document gives no separate adoption date, so the date used is its June 2018 publication.

note: No delivery fact: the captured text only says funding will come from government-industry partnership and the funding and monitoring sections were truncated.
BOCRA service-quality rules for operators (in force 2026-04-01); the captured text names no national broadband plan, so no fact on plan standing or delivery.
UASF Framework (Sept 2025) passages hold only the table of contents and definitions; the term hit is not in the held passages and no fund allocation is tied to a national broadband plan, so no fact.
